items.title: Anne Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2025
items.q: And we had everybody — Dave Brubeck, Lionel Hampton, Tito Puente, you name it.

ctx.x: If you do it this year.

It’s been done — last year it was the first time in Tucson, it’s been done for 30 years in Greensboro, North Carolina, they do it every single year. And Bozeman, Montana they did it. But the problem is that unless you can prove to a publisher — I was with Schirmer for the first ten years, and the only performances that came through Schirmer were ones that I found. And then I took it back, and now I have shipped it myself. But unless you can get it on television — and we did have a wonderful producer who is a…
It means a lot of money.
